Coordinator: Long shift, any word from the relief planner. I am trying to keep the Companion Animal Travel Desk calm for Aurelia Skyways today.
Planner: The handoff is still delayed, and I am sorry for the strain on the team.
Coordinator: <<FACT F019>>
Planner: I checked the care notes and matched the lounge plan with the booking file. We can keep the pet area quiet and steady.
Coordinator: That helps, and I appreciate the care. Some travelers are already worried, so I want a clear path before pickup.
Planner: <<FACT F018>>
Coordinator: Thank you. I will keep the desk informed and protect the pet relief handover.
Planner: Please do. We are treating each journey as a shared responsibility, and I do not want anyone left guessing.
Coordinator: Understood. I will note the updated plan, stay with the traveler, and make sure the pet is handled gently.
Planner: Good. I will return as soon as I can, and I am sorry again for the delay.
